messages:
alyssa: quick sync — i'm trialing a lightweight handoff we'll call 'stitchflow' for big accounts moving to live. goal: reduce cold-start noise + capture renewal signals during onboarding

miguel: curious, what are the pieces?

alyssa: short list — (1) prefill cache for top 20 prompts, (2) coordinated burst schedule for warm pools, (3) streaming fallbacks + client-side jitter, (4) feedback capture hook into cs ops

samira: how do we decide the top 20 prompts? and where does eng need to be involved?

alyssa: ask the customer during kickoff -> top intents + 5 golden prompts. cs owns collection, eng owns prefill job and routing rule. we put everything in a small envelope: prefill manifest + burst windows + telemetry tags

miguel: sample prefill manifest? can we automate it?

alyssa: yep — we added a tiny example config for eng:

```
# stitchflow_prefill.yaml
account_id: ACME-42
golden_prompts:
  - "summarize invoice 2023"
  - "extract line items"
prefill_window: 15m
burst_policy:
  initial_rate: 10r/s
  ramp: 60s
  sustain: 2r/s
telemetry_tags:
  cs_owner: alyssa
  experiment: stitchflow-v1
```

alyssa: eng runs a one-off prefill job on dedicated pool, then switches route to livemode after health checks pass.

samira: what about streaming fallbacks? we saw customers time out when they hit long-tail prompts

miguel: recommended: enable client streaming + server-side chunked responses. if backend latency > 400ms, fallback to a smaller quantized model and stream incremental tokens. add `x-prefetch-hint` header so runtime can use KV cache early.

alyssa: also: schedule two small bursts in first 15m, spaced by 90s, to keep kv-cache warm without hitting capacity spikes. we track token latency and error-rate in the first 2h — if error-rate > 2% flag cs for immediate remediation.

samira: renewal signal capture — how do we surface?

alyssa: embed a tiny feedback hook into onboarding flows:
- event: first 50 queries processed
- collect: avg latency, %streamed, top failing intents
- send: CS Ops webhook with subject `stitchflow/first-50` and attach customer comments

cs_bot: automated reminder scheduled in 24h to capture the first-50 hook if not received. :bell:

miguel: any TL;DR checklists for handoff?

alyssa: yes — three bullets for quick use:
1) CS: collect golden prompts + expected QPS + business-critical intents
2) Eng: run prefill with `stitchflow_prefill.yaml`, enable burst windows, confirm KV cache hit-rate > 60% after 10m
3) CS+Eng: enable streaming fallback policy, wire webhook `cs-op-feedback/stitchflow`, monitor first-2h telemetry and tag incident if errors spike

samira: neat — can we get a one-pager for the customer kickoff deck? i'll run it in our Friday enablement slot.

alyssa: i'll draft a 1-slide summary + short script by EOD. will post link here for review. :white_check_mark:

miguel: tiny note — add a short snippet for rollback: if latency or errors degrade during burst, route back to canary model and drain prefill pool. helps protect SLA.

alyssa: good call — will include rollback steps. thanks team.

cs_bot: stitchflow checklist created: https://internal.redwood/cs/stitchflow/1795554321 — reminder set for 24h.
